title: WA UTC Docket 260496 — Order - Other: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
summary: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
text:
Commission Docket No.: 
Agenda Date Assigned: 
BEFORE THE WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
LESS THAN STATUTORY NOTICE REQUESTED BY: 
Company Name: Columbia River Disposal, Inc. 
Certificate No. G-48 
UBI No. 603 430 603 
Registered Trade Name(s) Columbia River Disposal . 
Company proposes to change Tariff Number 8 
The company requests Commission approval to amend its filed Tariff Number 8 on Less than Statutory Notice to implement a 
Special Fuel Surcharge Tariff Supplement to recover the rising cost of fuel. Fuel index prices have increased from $2.837 per 
gallon for the base period to $6.000 per gallon current price. The Supplement would be in effect through July 31, 2026. Proposed 
change is to implement a 1.09% in Special Fuel Surcharge Supplement No. 14. Special Fuel Surcharge Supplement No. 13 will 
expire on June 30, 2026. The company request less than statutory notice allowing the customers to be noticed on the first bill as 
previously allowed per WAC 480-70-271(2)(a). 
(This section to be completed if filing is made by other than owner, partner, or corporate officer of the company) 
Name and title of issuing agent Brian Vandenburg, Financial Analyst is authorized to issue and file tariffs and/or time schedules 
on behalf of (name of company): Columbia River Disposal, Inc. 
Signature and title of authorizing agent (company official) Kevin Joyce, Region Controller. 
Telephone number/fax/e-mail of authorizing agent: Brian Vandenburg– 971-258-0746– Brian.Vandenburg@WasteConnections.com 
I request these provisions become effective: July 1, 2026 to expire on: July 31, 2026 
Signature and Title of Issuing Agent: Brian Vandenburg, Financial Analyst 
Printed name of Issuing Agent: Brian Vandenburg 
Telephone No. 971-258-0746 FAX No. N/A E-mail: Brian Vandenburg@WasteConnections.com
Mailing Address: 3440 Guignard Drive 
City: Hood River 
State: OR 
Zip: 97031 
WASHINGTON UTILITIES AND TRANSPORTATION COMMISSION 
O R D E R 
1.
The Commission finds good cause to support the request and authorize the proposed changes to become
effective with Less Than Statutory Notice on: July 1, 2026.
2.
The proposed changes will expire on: July 31, 2026.
3.
The temporary 1.09% fuel surcharge in all rates and charges is the result of increased fuel costs incurred by the
company during the month of May 2026, to be collected from customers as follows:
For customers who are billed monthly for services in arrears, the fuel surcharge applies to all services provided
in the month of July 2026.
